title: Periodic discrete graphs with prescribed spectrum
summary: We construct a periodic weighted graph whose discrete Laplacian has a spectrum with precisely $n$ gaps. Moreover, we show that by an appropriate choice of the weights, the endpoints of these gaps, as well as the upper edge of the spectrum, attain the prescribed values. The underlying graph has a brush-like geometry: it consists of an infinite chain of vertices, each of which is connected to $n$ additional pendant vertices by extra edges.
